## Verdict: REJECT (a sweep-introduced self-contradicting comment in the shipped installer)

## Issue Compliance
Reviewed against issue #2020: Finish brand DevFlow-to-PRFlow prose sweep (Batch 5) — criteria from the issue body; scope not-established (no workpad compared in this blinded shadow). Requirement-based checks are folded into the findings below.
- AC1/AC3 (no in-scope renameable `DevFlow` remains; lint clean; `pending_sweep_baseline` reseeded with no in-scope file): corroborated satisfied by two reviewers who ran `lib/test/lint-brand-devflow-sweep.py` (exit 0, 1145/1145 audited; reseeded baseline holds only out-of-scope areas).
- AC2 (no file outside the in-scope area edited): the supplied diff carries non-brand-sweep content (issue #2008 fingerprint code under `lib/test/**`, issue #2010/#2015 `skills/retrospective-weekly/SKILL.md` steps, version bumps to 2.34.58, CHANGELOG entries). The final-pass reviewer confirmed via `git merge-base --is-ancestor` that this is a STALE-BASE diff artifact — those commits are already ancestors of `origin/main`; the true `origin/main..HEAD` delta is brand-sweep-only. Treated as a base-staleness observation, not an AC2 violation.
- AC4 (frozen occurrences reclassified, not rewritten): spot-checked satisfied — `SHIM_MARKER 'Generated by DevFlow'`, `DevFlow Weekly Report`, `name: DevFlow Runner` signature grep, the `DevFlow-Reviewer` App name, and the `label:PRFlow,DevFlow` OR selector are all left frozen and bucketed.
- AC5 (reclassification evidenced in PR description): unestablished — PR description unavailable to this blinded shadow.

## Verification Checklist Results
No separate Phase 1/2 checklist was generated in this shadow structural re-review; the diff is classified `engine_self_modifying` (checklist not skipped). Requirement verification was carried by the Phase 3 roster.

## Code Review Findings
### 🔴 Critical
1. `install.sh` — the withheld-tier signature-guard comment was modified by this sweep to quote `"carries no PRFlow signature"` (line 1053), but the actual log the rc-1 arm emits (line 1069) is the frozen literal `carries no DevFlow signature`, correctly kept and bucketed in `lib/test/brand-devflow-buckets.json`. The comment now quotes a string that exists nowhere in the file — a self-contradiction this diff introduced. (raised by 2/5 agents) [self-contradicting-diff carve-out: install.sh]
   Fix: restore the comment's quoted phrase to `carries no DevFlow signature`, or freeze that comment occurrence in `brand-devflow-buckets.json` alongside the log literal it cites. Verified by the orchestrator against HEAD (install.sh:1052-1053 vs 1069) and against the diff hunk `@@ -1050,7 +1050,7` which changed `# DevFlow signature"` to `# PRFlow signature"`.

### 🟡 Suggestion / Minor
1. `README.md:175` — the marketing phrase `**DevFlow Reflection**` was swept to `**PRFlow Reflection**`; the actual workpad heading is the deliberately-frozen `## Devflow Reflection`. Introduces no new falsehood (the pre-sweep capital-F `DevFlow Reflection` already did not byte-match the frozen heading), so filed advisory only. (raised by 1/5 agents)
2. `lib/test/shard-tally.py` — two completeness-only test-coverage notes from pr-test-analyzer (the `subprocess.TimeoutExpired` arm is covered only transitively via the shared OSError handler; a sixth-field-tolerance case is unasserted). Non-blocking; the added fingerprint tests are otherwise thorough and RED-first. (raised by 1/5 agents)

## Verdict Criteria
The self-contradicting-diff carve-out (Phase 4.2, threshold-independent) fires on finding 1: a code comment the diff modified is false against HEAD. The Phase 4.1.5 behavior-inert prose cap does NOT rescue it — limb two fails closed because `install.sh` is downloaded by consumers who are explicitly instructed (docs/internal/install.md, docs/external installation.md: "Read the File Before Running It") to read it before running, so it cannot be established that no consumer reads this comment. Carve-out → REJECT, non-demotable, corroboration-independent. The remaining findings are all below the default `critical` verdict threshold.

Remediation is trivial (one-line comment fix or one bucket entry); the sweep is otherwise correct and carefully scoped.

Same defect as the comment-analyzer finding; graded lower by this agent, but Phase 4.1.6 promotes a diff-modified comment false against HEAD into the self-contradicting-diff carve-out regardless of the producing agent's grade.
README.md:175 — 'DevFlow Reflection' marketing phrase swept to 'PRFlow Reflection' while the actual workpad heading is the frozen '## Devflow Reflection'. Advisory only; no new falsehood introduced.

lib/test/shard-tally.py — the subprocess.TimeoutExpired arm of record-fingerprint is exercised only transitively via the shared OSError handler; adding an explicit slow-helper stub would be completeness-only.

lib/test/shard-tally.py — no test asserts a producer emitting a sixth field is tolerated (extra field ignored by five-field equality). Intended behavior; risk is only a future non-default producer's extra field being silently ignored.
